name: GST Period
expression: VAR A=MIN('GST Monthly'[Month]) VAR B=MAX('GST Monthly'[Month]) RETURN IF(ISBLANK(A),"No GST data in selection",FORMAT(A,"MMM yyyy") & " – " & FORMAT(B,"MMM yyyy"))

name: Bank Period
expression: VAR A=MIN('Bank Monthly'[Month]) VAR B=MAX('Bank Monthly'[Month]) RETURN IF(ISBLANK(A),"No banking data in selection",FORMAT(A,"MMM yyyy") & " – " & FORMAT(B,"MMM yyyy"))

name: Top Buyer Cr
expression: VAR R=RANKX(ALLSELECTED('GST Parties'[Party]),[Buyer Sales],,DESC,DENSE) RETURN IF(R<=6,[Buyer Sales Cr])

name: Top Supplier Cr
expression: VAR R=RANKX(ALLSELECTED('GST Parties'[Party]),[Supplier Purchases],,DESC,DENSE) RETURN IF(R<=6,[Supplier Purchases Cr])

name: Top Bank Receipts Cr
expression: VAR R=RANKX(ALLSELECTED('Bank Transactions'[Party]),[Gross Inflows],,DESC,DENSE) RETURN IF(R<=6,[Bank Inflows Cr])

name: Return Summary
expression: FORMAT([Cheque Return Count],"0") & " inward returns · ₹" & FORMAT([Cheque Return Amount]/100000,"0.00") & " lakh"

name: EMI Return Display
expression: IF(ISBLANK([EMI Return Count]),"Not reported",FORMAT([EMI Return Count],"0"))

name: Name Match Display
expression: FORMAT([Name Match Coverage],"0.0%") & " of receipts have an exact GST party name"

name: Finance Sales Growth
expression: VAR Y=VALUE(LEFT([Review Financial Year],4))-1 VAR P=FORMAT(Y,"0000") & "-" & FORMAT(Y+1,"0000") VAR V=CALCULATE(SUM('Financials'[Sales]),REMOVEFILTERS('Financials'),'Financials'[Financial Year]=P) RETURN IF(NOT ISBLANK(V),DIVIDE([FY Sales]-V,V))

name: Statement Current Cr
expression: DIVIDE(SWITCH(SELECTEDVALUE('Statement Layout'[Metric]),"FY Sales",[FY Sales],"FY Other Income",[FY Other Income],"FY Total Income",[FY Total Income],"FY Reported EBITDA",[FY Reported EBITDA],"FY Depreciation and Amortization",[FY Depreciation and Amortization],"FY Interest",[FY Interest],"FY Profit Before Tax",[FY Profit Before Tax],"FY Net Profit",[FY Net Profit],"Tangible Net Worth",[Tangible Net Worth],"Total Debt",[Total Debt],"FY Current Assets",[FY Current Assets],"FY Current Liabilities",[FY Current Liabilities],"FY Debtors",[FY Debtors],"FY Creditors",[FY Creditors],"FY Inventory",[FY Inventory],"Working Capital",[Working Capital],"FY Total Assets",[FY Total Assets]),10000000)

name: Statement Prior Cr
expression: VAR Y=VALUE(LEFT([Review Financial Year],4))-1 VAR P=FORMAT(Y,"0000") & "-" & FORMAT(Y+1,"0000") VAR Exists=COUNTROWS(FILTER(ALL('Review Year'),'Review Year'[Financial Year]=P)) RETURN IF(Exists>0,CALCULATE([Statement Current Cr],REMOVEFILTERS('Review Year'),TREATAS({P},'Review Year'[Financial Year])))

name: Statement Change
expression: VAR P=[Statement Prior Cr] RETURN IF(P>0,DIVIDE([Statement Current Cr]-P,P))
description: YoY growth only for positive prior base; negative/zero/absent prior base shown blank to avoid misleading percentages.

name: Credit Interpretation
expression: SWITCH(SELECTEDVALUE('Credit Notes'[Topic]),"Strength","Reported PAT ₹" & FORMAT([FY Net Profit]/100000,"0.00") & " lakh. " & IF(ISBLANK([Finance Sales Growth]),"No earlier comparable revenue supplied.","Revenue changed " & FORMAT([Finance Sales Growth],"+0.0%;-0.0%") & " versus prior FY."),"Weakness","Assess PAT margin " & FORMAT([Net Profit Margin],"0.00%") & "; debt/equity " & FORMAT([Debt Equity Ratio],"0.00") & "x; core interest cover " & FORMAT([Operating Interest Coverage],"0.00") & "x.","Opportunity","Obtain receivable ageing, cash-flow and principal-repayment schedules to verify collection and debt-servicing capacity.","Threat","Historical 2024 provider litigation and GST-delay flags require current verification. No bureau score is supplied.")

name: Calculation Numeric
expression: SWITCH(SELECTEDVALUE('Calculation Register'[No]),1,[EBIT],2,[EBITDA - PDF EBITA],3,[FY Net Profit],4,[EBIT],7,[Current Ratio],8,[Quick Ratio],9,[Debt Equity Ratio],10,[PDF Literal Adjusted Debt Equity],11,[Interest Coverage Ratio],12,[TOL TNW Ratio],13,[Net Profit Margin],14,[Debt EBITDA Ratio],16,[Reserves Equity Proxy],17,[Debtor Days],18,[Creditor Days],19,[Stock Days],20,[Working Capital Ratio])

name: Calculation Result
expression: VAR V=[Calculation Numeric] VAR U=SELECTEDVALUE('Calculation Register'[Unit]) VAR S=SELECTEDVALUE('Calculation Register'[Evidence Status]) RETURN IF(ISBLANK(V),IF(S="Banking tab","See Banking",IF(S="Finance tab","See Finance","Not available")),SWITCH(U,"Currency","₹ " & FORMAT(V/100000,"#,0.00") & " lakh","Percent",FORMAT(V,"0.00%"),"Days",FORMAT(V,"0.0") & " days",FORMAT(V,"0.00") & "x"))

name: Calculation Color
expression: SWITCH(SELECTEDVALUE('Calculation Register'[Evidence Status]),"Missing evidence","#B45309","Definition caveat","#A34D22","Proxy only","#A34D22","#117D75")

name: Tax and PAT Check
expression: IF(ABS([PAT Check])<0.01,"PAT reconciles to statements","PAT arithmetic needs review")
